drivers: one small team owning both source apps
strong consistency between cart, order, payment and review eligibility
modest scale with no part needing independent scaling
plan-mode project with no operations platform named

alternatives.reason: network calls and distributed data between cart, orders and reviews with no independent scaling or team need
would keep PyShop and NodeCart as two services in two runtimes, which is the split the merge removes
only the Stripe payment confirmation is asynchronous; one webhook handler covers it without a message bus
no part clearly needs a second style yet

style.reason: The simplest design that keeps cart, order and review eligibility in one transaction-consistent database

stack.frontend: Server-rendered Jinja2 templates with a small amount of vanilla JS
stack.database: PostgreSQL (SQLite for local development and tests)
stack.payments: Stripe Checkout (official Python SDK), test mode
stack.hosting: not decided by the user; any container host

reasons.backend: D01: the catalog (M01) is adapted from PyShop's Flask/SQLAlchemy code and the products are the durable data; Stripe has an official Python SDK, so NodeCart's two endpoints are rebuilt in Python
reasons.database: D02: one relational database keeps orders and review eligibility consistent; SQLAlchemy matches the adapted models
reasons.frontend: D03: no source has a frontend; server-rendered pages are the least moving parts for a small shop
reasons.payments: D04: keep Stripe Checkout from NodeCart, rebuilt with server-side line items and a verified webhook

modules.name: accounts
modules.responsibility: Sign-up, sign-in, sessions, roles and the single permission check (platform module; no source had it)

modules.name: checkout
modules.responsibility: Orders, Stripe Checkout sessions and the payment webhook

modules.name: reviews
modules.responsibility: Listing and writing product reviews, gated on a paid order

entities.name: User
entities.notes: No source has a User model; A and B carts reference a user id only

entities.name: Product
entities.notes: A's ids are kept; price becomes integer minor units plus currency

entities.name: Cart
entities.notes: Shape from B; one cart per user (unique user_id); B's cart rows are not migrated (decision D06)

entities.name: CartItem
entities.notes: quantity integer >= 1; unique (cart_id, product_id); product_id is a real foreign key to Product

entities.name: Order
entities.notes: status pending|paid|cancelled; paid only by the verified webhook

entities.name: Review
entities.notes: Modelled on Reviewly's documented behaviour (C-F01, C-F02, C-F04); no Reviewly data or code is imported; rating check 1..5; unique (user_id, product_id)

auth.session: server-side session id in an http-only, secure, SameSite=Lax cookie

navigation.screen: Product page with reviews and review form

design_system.tokens: colour roles (surface, text, primary, danger), 4px spacing scale, 1.25 type scale, 6px radius

slices.name: Browse and add to cart (core loop)

decisions.decision: One Python/Flask/SQLAlchemy backend; NodeCart's endpoints rebuilt in Python
decisions.reason: Catalog (durable data) and its model are in PyShop; Stripe has an official Python SDK; one runtime instead of two
Keeps A's product ids; B's uuid keys only belonged to transient carts
No source has a frontend; fewest moving parts

decisions.decision: Stripe Checkout with server-built line items and a signature-verified webhook
decisions.reason: Fixes the critical client-price flaw and gives the review gate a confirmed order

decisions.decision: New accounts module (email+password, http-only cookie session, roles customer/owner)
decisions.reason: No source has identity, but carts, checkout and reviews need a user

decisions.decision: Do not migrate NodeCart's cart rows; migrate PyShop's products with price converted to integer minor units
decisions.reason: Carts are transient; products are durable; see migration-plan.md

decisions.decision: Unversioned REST under /api, error shape {"error": {"code", "message"}}, page/limit pagination on lists
decisions.reason: One API style; Reviewly's /v2 paths are not copied

decisions.decision: Review gate refuses (403) reviews without a paid order containing the product
decisions.reason: Reviewly's refuse-vs-hide rule is undocumented; refusing is simpler and testable
